purpose: Reader-facing map by named result; historical directory names are preserved input identities, not required reading order.
proof_status: Mathematical proofs are read, not executed. Named result headings identify proof locations; historical bound texts are frozen dependencies rather than the current article.
input_rule: All listed scripts, data, support texts and expected outputs are hash-bound by frozen_manifest.json. Program-defined finite cases and exact formulas are embedded in the checker source where no separate input is listed.
additional_selected_checks: The complete historical set is enumerated in legacy/p24/reproducibility/Replay_Input_Manifest.json (26 programs, 27 outputs). Historical nested archives are retained provenance and are not additional current executions.
